summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting that it submitted its Annual Securities Report (ASR) for fiscal year April 1, 2025 through March 31, 2026 to Japan's Kanto Regional Finance Bureau on September 18, 2026, under Japan's Financial Instruments and Exchange Law. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine foreign-issuer annual disclosure filing, the equivalent of a US annual report on Form 20-F, with no special-situation mechanics or risk-arb angle.
